question: Find the value of 3 × 6 + 5 - 6 ÷ 2 - 9 + 72 ÷ (3 × 4) + 42
solution:
**Given:**

Find the value of 3 × 6 + 5 - 6 ÷ 2 - 9 + 72 ÷ (3 × 4) + 42

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction

**Calculation:**

3 × 6 + 5 - 6 ÷ 2 - 9 + 72 ÷ (3 × 4) + 42

⇒ 18 + 5 - 3 - 9 + 72 ÷ 12 + 42

⇒ 18 + 5 - 3 - 9 + 6 + 42

⇒ 23 - 3 - 9 + 6 + 42

⇒ 11 + 6 + 42

⇒ 59

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
